blocks.tamil_translation: are with Him alone; none (else) knows them except Him; and He knows whatever is on land and in the sea; not even a leaf falls without His knowing it - there is no seed in the darkness of the earth, nothing green and nothing dry, that is not in (His) clear Record (the Lawh al-Mahfuz). And He is the One who takes your souls by night (in sleep), and He knows what you earn by day; then He raises you up in it (the day) so that the appointed term may be fulfilled; then to Him is your (final) return; then He will inform you of what you used to do (in the world).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ أَغَيْرَ اللهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِياًّ فَاطِرِالسَّموَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَايُطْعَمُ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say: Shall I take as a protector (to be worshipped and sought for help) anyone other than Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He feeds (everyone); (but) He is not fed (by others).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَإِنْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ ز وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: There is not a thing - except that its treasures are with Us (and with no one else) - and We do not send it down except in a known measure.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَيَبْتَغُونَ عِنْدَهُمُ الْعِزَّةَ فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلّهِ جَمِيعاً۞).
